name: eig
expr: e1 = eig(A); e2 = eig(D); ei = eig(eye(4)); [V, M] = eig(A); err = max(max(abs(A*V - V*M))); orth_v = max(max(abs(V'*V - eye(3))));
comment: Sig: e = eig(A) | [V, D] = eig(A). Symmetric Jacobi for real symmetric A; eigenvalues ascending. General (non-symmetric) eig requires Hessenberg + Francis QR -- Phase 2b.
